q1_issues.issue: "nearly 4 points" is rendered as the symmetric distribution (ParticleFromNormal 4 0.4), which puts probability mass above 4; "nearly" entails a value below 4, and the hedge rule covers only about/around/roughly/approximately.
Both the scale slot and the unit slot are filled with point, so the atom records no dimension for the change, and it puts a non-duration Measure on an event witness.
The closing level 1,066.62 is asserted as a free-standing past Measure with nothing linking it to sk_pull_back_1, so the parse does not record that this is the value the pull-back reached.

q2_gaps: a measured EXTENT OF CHANGE on an event ("pulled back by nearly 4 points") — Measure's scale/unit contract is for a dimension of an entity, MoreBy is a two-entity comparative, and no head records the size of a rise or fall
the ENDPOINT value reached by a change ("to 1,066.62") — no licensed relation ties a resulting measure to the event that produced it (Result links to a reified state, not to a measure)
one-sided approximators ("nearly / almost / just over / up to N") — only symmetric-sigma hedges are defined, so a bound-directional approximation has no faithful encoding
index points as a measurement unit with no underlying dimension noun — the scale slot has nothing to take
notes: Name handling is right: the lowercase "stock index" is kept out of the name symbol and stated as an ordinary type atom with its compound genus, and the phrasal verb pull_back is kept whole with no genus.
